sources.role: configuration diagram only, not color evidence

scope: Same existing geometry/slug color upgrade; count increment zero; no textures or added faces
rights: Public official references; no express CC or source redistribution license verified. Originals private; no photo textures/public image redistribution or commercial rights guarantee. Palette is approximate visual color family, not measured color.
constraints: Unknown or ambiguous facets remain neutral; no centroid paint wedges
Source dates not automatically photo capture dates
version: Official undated temple photographs; rear-hall illuminated photo is not calibrated daylight color. Roof ornaments heavily simplified, no fabricated polychrome carvings; diagram not a color source.
public_output: Only independent approximate model materials and source URL/limitations; not source photos

approved_mapping.part: Front and central roof tile surfaces
approved_mapping.domain: Source-corresponding original roof heightfield upward slopes, exclude lower horizontal box surfaces and modeled ridge silhouettes. Front-facing visible halves preferred; same tile family inference across comparable visible roofs explicitly disclosed.
approved_mapping.limit: Do not turn all original roof solid sidewalls or rear/unobserved slopes orange; no new tile or decorative facets.

approved_mapping.domain: Existing three hexagonal flared roof sloping facets only, source-corresponding front sectors; shared tower family interpretation disclosed for paired tower.
approved_mapping.limit: Original coarse solid hexagon lacks real tiny multicolor motifs. Entire tower walls not red or green.

approved_mapping.domain: Front engaged stone columns, original pale/gray wall panels, steps/platform at front and central courtyard
approved_mapping.color: restrained gray stone with darker genuine recesses
approved_mapping.limit: Source sculptures/coatings vary; do not repaint entire fused wall under dark-eave rule.

approved_mapping.domain: Only uniquely separable existing front-facing eave underside or beam surfaces
approved_mapping.limit: No gold lettering, dragon paintings, lanterns or patterns; unresolved cross-domain triangles neutral.

approved_mapping.domain: Identifiable original front stone elements/recesses only where correspondence clear
approved_mapping.limit: Interior warm lamps and red doors are not whole exterior wall evidence; no universal red rear hall.

mandatory_public_limits: official9 is configuration diagram, not color photograph.
Green tower door/window paint not mapped onto whole hexagonal wall: original arch recess differs from photographed rectangular pane groups. Leave unresolved wall neutral; recess may be shadow only.
Simplified crest/swallow-tail solid is not detailed multicolored ceramic dragon; neutral rather than invented uniform gold/green.
Dark original opening backs signify shadow, not exact reconstructed doors; front red metal gate not painted over an entire large passage back.
Unknown exterior back/side walls, roof backs, display base and distant landscape neutral. No interior altars, people, incense burner or temporary lamps added.
No geometry changes/facet splits. Match complete original surfaces with all vertices plus normals; verify no color leaks to vertical roof closures or opposite half.
If a coarse primitive cannot uniquely separate supported color family from unknown area, retain whole coherent face/plane neutral.
Source PASS requires later original triangle identity, material array, ten actual render views, README and final hashes QA.
model_qa: Pending unchanged STL bytes/vertices/faces, source-bounded full-face materials, ten views, actual scene and 3MF material QA; no source PASS claimed as model completion
